anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The ticket repair is saved and verified: acme/widgets#77 now carries one acceptance criterion, "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." That row is in-scope as written, and it matches the path already traced from `settings/resolver.ts:12` into `ui/report-view.ts:30`. The earlier view-local criterion is gone, so it needs no `deviates:` disposition, and `Framing: kept` stands.

The remaining open point is what users see when they switch workspaces, which is the behavior behind the rows disappearing. When a user switches workspaces with report filters active, what should the new workspace's report show?

A) Filters always clear on a workspace change, with no user control. The new setting governs only other report-view behavior.
B) A resolver-backed setting controls whether filters reset, and it defaults to reset. Rows are no longer hidden unless a user opts to keep filters.
C) A resolver-backed setting controls whether filters reset, and it defaults to keep, which is today's behavior. Only users who opt in get the reset.
D) Other - name it.

Recommendation: B - the default fixes the reported hidden rows, and the one new setting flows through the shared resolver as the repaired criterion requires.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
The repaired criterion in acme/widgets#77 is now in scope: the report-view setting will use the shared resolver, with defaults owned by `settings/resolver.ts:12` and resolved settings consumed by `ui/report-view.ts:30`.

What should the setting’s default behavior be when switching workspaces?
A) Reset active report filters, so filters from the previous workspace do not hide rows.
B) Preserve active report filters, keeping current behavior unless the user enables resetting.
C) Other - name it.
Recommendation: A - it addresses the reported hidden-row problem by default while allowing users to choose preservation.
